title: Keep peace alive with Bani
summary: Peace stays living when Bani keeps sounding within it. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.

source.shortMeaning: Peace stays living when Bani keeps sounding within it.
